policy_floor: Echo cursor sources routed row, clause 'a transient read failure throws IncompleteCaptureError and RETAINS the cursor'
reporter: FortitudeEtc review of b8ec3fe15, adopted by cpp-safety
trigger: RegEnumKeyExW(HKEY_USERS) answers an error part-way (access denied, handle failure) while a loaded user hive is mid-list
classification_rationale: enumerate_hku returned a partial list that collect() committed as the authoritative loaded-user list
summary: enumerate_hku now walks through walk_enumeration and throws IncompleteCaptureError unless the walk ended at ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS; collect()'s rollback restores the HKU mark; start() arms nothing. Fixed in dae3f44b0 and 363371b35.

trigger: an HKEY_USERS subkey name that fills the 256-wide buffer (ERROR_MORE_DATA)
classification_rationale: the request says every non-end result throws; the code skipped ERROR_MORE_DATA (unreachable: key names are at most 255 characters)
summary: The skip branch is removed; ERROR_MORE_DATA throws with every other error. d5954a6ef.

trigger: a later edit reverts the loop to 'stop on any error'; the regression case injects the throw itself so it still passes
classification_rationale: the end-of-list decision lived in Windows-only code no unit test could reach
summary: The decision is now walk_enumeration, a pure function in echo_registry_parsers.hpp with four cases (end, empty, error part-way, error at index 0), mutation-verified; the failed-enumeration case also pins the watch set and a status key. 363371b35, bb336d50e.

trigger: start() takes the same list; its new catch had no test
classification_rationale: a mutation removing the catch passed every test
summary: A start-up case fails the enumeration at start(), requires no throw and no watch, then a retry that baselines; mutation-verified. b5d08af74.

trigger: a reader of the changelog fragment or docs/echo-implementer.md
classification_rationale: the new rule was in neither the fragment nor the implementer guide; the first wording said 'complete' for an index-driven walk and 'before any dirty mark is touched' though the mark is taken and put back
summary: One sentence in the fragment and a passage in the guide, worded as 'ended without an error' and 'the HKU mark it took is put back'. d5954a6ef, 363371b35.

trigger: a later edit makes the RegEnumKeyExW result mapping return End for a non-success code
classification_rationale: the five-line rc-to-step mapping and the throw run only on Windows and an error cannot be induced
summary: Recorded limit: compile-checked on MSVC at the final source and desk-checked by three reviewers; the decision logic is pinned by walk_enumeration.

classification_rationale: the driver warns, counts capture_incomplete and exposes registry_last_status and consecutive_failures, but emits no capture_gap row after N failures and the warn is not rate-limited
summary: Not a duty of the routed row and inherited from the driver; no change here. A tick-level failure also stalls the whole registry source (the request requires the throw before anything is touched). Recorded design note.
